scope: Current README and docs root guides: every Wood fenced block explicitly classified; reports/releases are historical evidence, not executable example suites.

modules.name: binary
modules.summary: Endian-explicit signed and nonnegative integer wire formats.

modules.name: collections
modules.summary: Stable integer sorting/search and generic Stack, Queue and Heap.

modules.name: csv
modules.summary: Whole-document quoted CSV parsing, serialization and header tables.

modules.name: env
modules.summary: Read-only owned environment values, distinguishing absence from empty strings.

modules.name: fs
modules.summary: Bounded filesystem listing, traversal and explicit creation/removal.

modules.name: functional
modules.summary: Eager callback-first type-safe collection algorithms.

modules.name: geometry
modules.summary: Triangle meshes, finite geometry, transforms and bounded OBJ I/O.

modules.name: http
modules.summary: Bounded synchronous connection-close HTTP messages and endpoints.

modules.name: https
modules.summary: Verified HTTPS over optional OpenSSL 3 streams.

modules.name: io
modules.summary: Scoped binary file streams and bounded copying.

modules.name: iter
modules.summary: Lazy source-first adapters, owned cursor protocols and consumers.

modules.name: linalg
modules.summary: Vec3 arithmetic, affine transforms and partial-pivoted linear solves.

modules.name: math
modules.summary: Checked integer GCD, LCM, power and clamping.

modules.name: net
modules.summary: Synchronous deadline-bound TCP connections/listeners and half-close.

modules.name: num
modules.summary: Fixed-shape typed numeric arrays, views, conversions and kernels.

modules.name: path
modules.summary: Host path assembly, canonical identities and link-aware containment.

modules.name: python
modules.summary: EXPERIMENTAL LLVM-only CPython 3.14 interoperability; explicit managed objects and conversions.

modules.name: random
modules.summary: OS-backed cryptographic bytes and unbiased bounded integers; no insecure fallback.

modules.name: sqlite
modules.summary: Prepared statements, bounded JSON rows and rollback scopes; optional SQLite.

modules.name: stats
modules.summary: Checked integer totals and binary64 online/scaled statistics.

modules.name: task
modules.summary: Joinable threads, immutable JSON messages and explicit socket handoff.

modules.name: time
modules.summary: Blocking sleep and monotonic elapsed-time counters.

modules.name: tls
modules.summary: Verified TLS clients, server contexts and stream handoff; optional OpenSSL.

modules.name: utf8
modules.summary: Strict Unicode scalar decoding/encoding over byte strings.
